change: Box 2 (Truck & Issue Details) on Log Breakdown is now its own independent collapsible toggle, matching the Paste WhatsApp box -- previously it always showed automatically as soon as 'Report a New Breakdown' was opened. Now tapping 'Report a New Breakdown' only reveals Box 1 (Paste toggle + Date/Time); Box 2's fields stay hidden until its own header is tapped. Both Box 2 and the outer form auto-collapse again after a successful submit.
